name: madhukar-general-store
description: Production-Ready Scalable E-Commerce + Billing + Delivery Platform for Madhukar General Store

scripts.postinstall: npx prisma generate && npm install --prefix frontend/customer && npm install --prefix frontend/admin && npm install --prefix backend && cp -r node_modules/.prisma backend/node_modules/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['frontend/customer/.next', 'frontend/admin/.next', '.next'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.dev: npm run clean && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --prefix frontend/customer && npm run build --prefix frontend/admin
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend/customer" "npm run start --prefix frontend/admin"
scripts.db:push: npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate && mkdir -p backend/prisma && cp prisma/dev.db backend/prisma/dev.db 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r node_modules/.prisma backend/node_modules/ 2>/dev/null || true
